title: Daniel is the best! Give him a raise!
text: Daniel was so amazing, we learned so many things and the hours passed without me realising it. I wish all tours were like this, friendly, so explanatory but yet managing to explain in a good way.

title: Incredible Tour Guide
text: Such a GREAT tour! Our guide was Mariah. She was so knowledgeable, so interesting and made the tour both heartbreakeningly real and so funny. She was so quick on her feet and her historical accounts were flawless. The history of the sights we saw was breathtaking. Best tour ive ever been on. I recommend getting a tour with her. It’s an elevated experience.
